title: Learning Curve for Vehicle Technology
summary: Reviewers describe an adjustment period for learning the vehicle’s electronics, controls, driver-assistance functions, and broader technology, without enough context to determine whether they view that experience positively or negatively.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention a learning curve around electronics, features, controls, and driver-assistance behavior, but do not clearly state satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: All sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, so sentiment direction cannot be established from the available examples.
The examples are brief and mostly note a learning curve without enough detail to separate normal familiarization from a specific usability problem.
Samples are stratified and not representative estimates of the full owner population.
